About Me

Welcome to my corner of the digital world. I'm Chukwuma Akunyili, a software engineer with a passion for functional programming, elegant systems design, and pushing the boundaries of what's possible in software.

My Journey

My path in software engineering has been defined by curiosity and a relentless pursuit of deeper understanding. From my early days tinkering with code to my current professional endeavors, I've always sought to bridge the gap between theoretical elegance and practical solutions.

Technical Interests

  • Functional Programming: OCaml, F#, and the pursuit of expressive, correct and safe code
  • Systems Design: Designing robust, scalable, fault‑tolerant architectures using microservices, distributed systems, and event‑driven (CQRS) patterns
  • Extended Reality (XR): VR/AR applications with impact, particularly in healthcare
  • Formula 1: The technical aspects of racing and performance optimization

Beyond Coding

When I'm not writing code, you might find me:

  • Analyzing Formula 1 racing strategies and technical innovations
  • Exploring immersive technologies and their applications in solving problems
